name: Gobusata Daddy "Kaishun Massage Hen"
original_name: ごぶさたダディ「回春マッサージ編」
source: One day, Sunamiya Takanori receives a coupon for a free massage. But when he arrives at what he thinks is a men's beauty salon, he discovers that it's actually a gay massage parlor...
